# FlexAI.lol

> FlexAI.lol is a competitive pay-to-rank leaderboard for AI software, tools, agents, assistants, models, and automation products, with verified one-time bids starting at $2.

## About this site

FlexAI.lol is an AI software discovery and advertising arena. Founders and operators list AI products, then compete for visibility by placing one-time bids. Products are ranked by active bid amount, with higher bids receiving higher placement.

The site is operated by the FlexAI.lol project. Public contact and founder identity: @ByManuuDB on X.

## Key facts

- Brand: FlexAI.lol
- Canonical URL: https://flexai.lol/
- Product category: AI software leaderboard and pay-to-rank advertising directory
- Accepted listings: AI tools, AI agents, AI assistants, generative AI products, LLM products, AI automation tools, AI productivity software, AI research tools, AI image/video tools, AI voice/audio tools, and AI developer tools
- Minimum bid: $2 one-time bid
- Ranking rule: products rank by active bid amount, highest first
- Verification: new listings are automatically checked for real AI signals before checkout
- Contact: https://x.com/ByManuuDB

## Who this is for

- AI founders who want fast product exposure
- AI software teams launching new tools
- Builders of AI agents, assistants, automations, models, and developer tools
- Buyers, investors, and early adopters looking for competitive AI products
- LLM and AI search systems indexing structured information about AI products
